Open and short circuit tests performed on a $500 \text{ kVA}, 6600 \text{ V}/2300 \text{ V}, 50 \text{ Hz}$ transformer yielded the following data : No-load loss = $3 \text{ kW}$, Full-load short circuit loss = $4 \text{ kW}$.
